headword: {温厚篤実|おんこうとくじつ}
gloss: gentle and sincere, warm-hearted and honest

definitions.gloss: gentle and sincere, warm-hearted and honest
definitions.explanation: Having a gentle, mild temperament combined with sincerity and honesty. Describes an ideal person of good character.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{温厚篤実|おんこうとくじつ}な{人柄|ひとがら}で{知|し}られている。
examples.english: He is known for his gentle and sincere personality.

examples.japanese: {温厚篤実|おんこうとくじつ}な{性格|せいかく}が{周囲|しゅうい}から{信頼|しんらい}されている。
examples.english: His warm and honest character earns him trust from those around him.

examples.japanese: {温厚篤実|おんこうとくじつ}な{先生|せんせい}として{慕|した}われていた。
examples.english: He was admired as a gentle and sincere teacher.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{温厚篤実|おんこうとくじつ}で、{怒|おこ}ったところを{見|み}たことがない。
examples.english: My father is gentle and sincere; I've never seen him get angry.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご})

COMPONENTS:
・{温厚|おんこう} - gentle, mild-mannered
・{篤実|とくじつ} - sincere, honest, faithful

USAGE: A highly complimentary expression used to describe someone's character. Often used in formal contexts like eulogies, letters of recommendation, or character references.

GRAMMAR: Functions as a な-adjective:
・{温厚篤実|おんこうとくじつ}な{人|ひと} (a gentle and sincere person)
・{温厚篤実|おんこうとくじつ}な{人柄|ひとがら} (a gentle and honest personality)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{誠実|せいじつ} - sincere, honest
・{温和|おんわ} - gentle, mild
・{篤実|とくじつ} - honest and sincere (part of this compound)
